about: Kit descriptors for the sprite baker (match_art.py), per season and club id (gamedata clubs.json). Seeded from docs/data/history/clubs/<id>.md. 'uncertain': true = the whole kit is a guess or the layout is not sourced; 'guessed' lists the parts filled in without a source. Colours are #rrggbb; 'pattern' is plain, halves, quarters, hoops, stripes, sash or spots; 'colours' are the shirt colours in pattern order (halves/quarters: wearer's left first). 'caps': outfield players wear caps. Shin pads are worn outside the stockings unless 'shinPads' is false.

preston-north-end.notes: White shirts, navy/dark knickerbockers (club tradition: white from about 1888); socks not found.

aston-villa.notes: Chocolate and sky blue proposed Nov 1886; layout unknown (halves drawn); white knickerbockers an inference.

wolverhampton-wanderers.notes: Red and white vertical stripes, dark knickerbockers and socks (1888-89 squad photo, per the club).

blackburn-rovers.notes: Blue and white halves, white knickerbockers, blue socks (1878 photo); shade of blue disputed, Cambridge blue drawn.

bolton-wanderers.notes: Not confirmed for 1888-89; the 1884 white-with-red-spots kit is drawn.

west-bromwich-albion.notes: Light blue and white stripes from 1885-86; knickers/socks not found.

accrington.notes: Red jerseys, serge-blue knickers (1888-92); socks not found.

everton.notes: Not confirmed; salmon pink and dark blue stripes (from the sequence before ruby) drawn as a guess.

burnley.notes: White with a blue sash from Dec 1887 (sources conflict with all-blue/all-white); knickers/socks not found.

derby-county.notes: Amber, chocolate and light blue (cricket club colours 1884-94); layout not found, hoops drawn.

notts-county.notes: Chocolate and blue halves (from 1880); knickers/socks not found.

stoke.notes: Red and white stripes (from 1883 or c.1878); knickers/socks not found.

old-westminsters.notes: Pink and white; exact pattern not found.

swifts.notes: Black shirts with a white swift, white knickerbockers, black stockings (from 1877; not confirmed for 1888-89). Badge not drawn.

old-brightonians.notes: Blue and white hoops (1880s photographs), striped cap (drawn plain blue).

wrexham.notes: Not confirmed; scarlet and black by 1876, first recorded home shirt red and black hoops.

nottingham-forest.notes: Garibaldi red; other details not found.

witton.notes: Blue and white (from 1882), dark blue recorded 1889, blue knickers; layout not found.

bootle.notes: Blue and white in various combinations; 1888-89 kit not found.

chatham-town.notes: Red and blue 1-inch hoops (1882-83, 1887-89); drawn at the smallest readable band.

grimsby-town.notes: Chocolate and blue quarters from 1884 per one source (another: varying designs); white shorts, black socks.

halliwell.notes: Probably white jerseys edged with blue, dark knickers.

old-carthusians.notes: Pink and dark blue (cerise added 1885); layout not found.

derby-junction.notes: Amber and black stripes, white shorts, black socks (from 1887).

sheffield-wednesday.notes: Blue and white; quarters recorded for 1887.

birmingham-st-georges.notes: White shirts with black collars (ordered 1888); badge not drawn.

long-eaton-rangers.notes: White shirts with red trim, white knickers (from 1887).

small-heath.notes: Dark blue with a sash (white, yellow or red), date of that kit not given; white sash drawn.

walsall.notes: Red and white (search summary only); layout not found.

heeley.notes: Violet and black halves (hoops until c.1888).
